Scripts.OnEnter:
if self:GetParent().HeaderIcon.PointsSpentBgGold:IsShown() then self:GetParent().HeaderIcon.PointsSpentBgGoldHighlight:Show() else self:GetParent().HeaderIcon.PointsSpentBgSilverHighlight:Show() end
self:GetParent().HeaderIcon.PrimaryBorderHighlight:Show() self:GetParent().HeaderBorderHighlight:Show()
GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetText(TALENT_HEADER_SUMMARY_TOOLTIP_HEADER) GameTooltip:AddLine(TALENT_HEADER_SUMMARY_TOOLTIP, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b, 1) GameTooltip:Show()

Scripts.OnLoad: if self.NameFrame and self.Name then self.NameFrame:SetWidth(160) self.Name:SetSize(130, 36) self.Name:ClearAllPoints() self.Name:SetPoint("LEFT", self.NameFrame, 18, 2) end
Scripts.OnEnter: if self.spellID then GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink(strconcat("spell:", self.spellID)) end

Scripts.OnLoad: self.showRetrievingText = true self.Text:SetText(TALENT_LOADING_LABEL) self.Text:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) self.Dots:SetTextColor(HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b)

Scripts.OnEnter: local name, icon, amount, itemID, itemLink = C_Talent.GetCurrencyInfo(1) GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink(itemLink) GameTooltip:Show()
local name, icon, amount, itemID, itemLink = C_Talent.GetCurrencyInfo(2) GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") GameTooltip:SetHyperlink(itemLink) GameTooltip:Show()

GameTooltip:SetOwner(self, "ANCHOR_RIGHT", 6, 0) GameTooltip:SetText(TALENT_IMPORT_TOOLTIP_NAME, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.r, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.g, HIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR.b) GameTooltip:AddLine(TALENT_IMPORT_TOOLTIP_TEXT, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.r, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.g, NORMAL_FONT_COLOR.b, true) GameTooltip:Show()
